dynamic.label: dynamic
dynamic.units: hbar=1; lattice spacing=1; all energies in declared input hopping units; phi is dimensionless
dynamic.reference: full N2 ground-space maximally mixed projector; no phi-sign selection, no selected unoccupied one-particle vacuum

source_current_event.preparation: normalized coherent N3 source on first neutral ground eigenvector; neutral unique or else explicit first-vector event only
source_current_event.pulse: exp(-i pulse Jx), Jx=dH/dkx actual uniform Peierls link derivative; not spin

all_virtual_G.dimension: 4x4 source matrix; full N1/N3 scalar-Fock spectra, no upper cutoff
